wec4_activation.body:
Propose a complete standalone WEC V4 successor to WEC V3. The behavior delta is limited to remote pre-plan and Owner-resume evidence reads: release the admission lock during collection, then reacquire it and validate exact prerequisites before using the result. Other lock obligations and UNKNOWN / single-writer boundaries are preserved.

The proposal remains proposed with implementation and production authority set to none. Acceptance and predecessor retirement require a later Owner transaction. This PR must not be merged by this delivery task.

Validation: the unchanged 842-line proposal retains SHA-256 77b3e31b772e7502e08dc2544961737df8b0ca5001464f7084f87453310fc5a7 and the recorded independent semantic PASS with 10/10 Contract-to-Acceptance coverage. R4 removes the receipt EOF blank line; staged whitespace check rc0. The receipt and appended stop history record the delivery steps. No source or production changes; product tests were not run.

pr_open.body:
When a workflow admission waits for remote pre-plan or Owner-resume evidence, the shared ledger lock blocks unrelated eligible admissions. Apply accepted WEC V4's bounded exception: capture under the existing lock, release only for those two collection reads, then reacquire with fresh replay and exact local/external validation before the existing locked plan/WAL/delivery sequence.

The R2 test correction preserves fail-closed canonical validation. A malformed/ambiguous feed yields pre_plan_unavailable with zero plan/delivery; a later clean ordinary sweep freshly validates and admits. The original failure was ledger count 0, while admissions.length was already 1. Authority: WEC4 CTR-WEC4-010 steps 2/4 and refusal/later-sweep clauses, alongside PPR CTR-WAE-001.

Validation: existing workflow 333/333 rc0; integration 29/29 rc0; broker 80/80 rc0. The unchanged 37/37 lock-timing GREEN and two-writer RED evidence is rebound by exact input hashes. Both real writer intervals allow B to finish during A collection; required final validation retains a measured lock-held wait (403 ms in the dedicated barrier case). Independent affected-Contract semantic review PASS at f1db5b4c382b25ae12769b7e7091de35f2645500, zero blockers.

Receipt and original RED/GREEN/failure stdout are being finalized in RECEIPT-1366-IMPL.md and docs/evidence/1366-locktiming/. Existing diagnostic-read separation is unchanged. Source/mechanism validation only; no production activation or live business result. This task must leave the PR open and unmerged; do not enable auto-merge.
